A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable versions of DREAM, with matching methods, experiments and references. Inspection distinguishes appendix material incorporated into v3 from material absent from the supplied later PDF.

before.justification: v1 reports original computational profiling, speedup and token-acceptance measurements, architectural ablations, sensitivity analyses and statistical comparisons.

after.justification: v3 retains original profiling and experimental results in Figures 2 and 4 and Tables 1–3, including benchmark comparisons and ablations.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same cross-attention architecture, entropy-based feature selection, losses, visual-token compression and tree decoding. The added offline-calibration paragraph supplies implementation information without establishing a replacement algorithm; revised parameter counts do not identify an architectural change.

E1.justification: Both use LLaVA mix665k and the same six reported benchmarks: MMT-Bench, SEED-Bench-2, ScienceQA, OCRBench, ChartQA and MathVista. Newly documented sampling details do not establish additional dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains identical comparator membership within each model and temperature setting: SPD, Kangaroo, Medusa, Hydra, EAGLE and EAGLE-2 where applicable. Table 2 also retains the same architectural controls and EAGLE-2 depth variants.

E3.justification: Section 4 substantially revises reported draft-model sizes: 0.24B to 0.65B for LLaVA-7B, 0.37B to 0.98B for LLaVA-13B, and 0.56B to 0.9B for both Pixtral and Gemma3. This changes the stated computational scale, although the PDFs do not establish rerunning experiments. Other previously specified settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The architecture, intermediate-feature selection, tree-versus-chain, compression-rate and loss-weight analyses are retained. v1 Appendix A3 and Table 3 move into v3 Section 4.2 with the same compression settings and results; this is not a new sensitivity experiment.

E5.justification: v3 omits Appendix A4 and Table 4, removing the paper's 95% confidence intervals, p-values and Bonferroni-corrected significance tests against six baselines. Fixed-seed and three-run averaging statements remain, relocated from v1 Appendix A2, so they are not newly introduced statistical practices.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and the profiling and ablation plots retain their numerical results. The omission of Table 4 removes additional effect estimates and test outcomes, including the reported EAGLE-2 differences of 0.79 in speedup and 0.42 in acceptance length, with p-values 0.0005 and 0.0280.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(4) remain unchanged. Removing Appendix A1 eliminates the explicit mathematical definition of a candidate's global acceptance score as the product of draft confidences along its ancestral path.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same three innovations, VLM acceleration scope, claimed speedup up to 3.6× and advantages over existing speculative-decoding methods.

C2.justification: v3 explains acceptance lengths above six through the additional token generated by the target model. It omits Appendix A4's interpretation of statistical results as evidence of robustness and output quality. The main performance explanations, compression interpretation and NVIDIA-only evaluation limitation remain.

D1.justification: v3 substantially changes reproducibility documentation: it specifies stratified splitting with seed 42, training/test sample selection, target-generated training responses and cached offline entropy calibration. Conversely, Appendix A1's detailed expansion, pruning, ancestor-retention and tie-breaking instructions disappear. Most baseline implementation information from Appendix A2 is retained in Section 4.

R1.justification: The 64 references and substantive related-work discussion match. DREAM's positioning relative to EAGLE, multimodal speculative decoding and intermediate-feature distillation is unchanged.

P1.justification: Most main-text prose remains verbatim. Local revisions expand Section 4, integrate Appendix A2 and A3 material, omit the remaining appendix sections, and update affiliations, equal-contribution information and the conference header.

P2.justification: v3 removes the tree-generation illustration, Figure 5, and statistical Table 4. Table 3 moves into Section 4.2 with a shortened caption and wrapped layout; Tables 1 and 2 are resized or repositioned. The principal diagrams and ablation plots remain visually unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reproducibility through explicit data-split, training-response and calibration details, and makes existing compression results easier to locate. However, it removes detailed tree-decoding instructions and all confidence-interval and significance-test reporting. The substantial parameter-count revisions are unexplained, while benchmark results remain identical. These opposing changes leave the net quality effect uncertain.
